purpose: Teach: 履き/怪しげ/一人前/ありゃ/競う/似合わ/着々と/とてつもなく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと新しい下駄を履きに行ったぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, we went to get new geta together.
lines.style: Slow, measured recollection. Voice softens on the memory. Slight pause before speaking, as if reaching back in time. Warm undertone—this is a cherished moment he's holding onto.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、怪しげな商人を見抜く目をお持ちでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—your grandfather had such a keen eye for spotting a shady merchant, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, affectionate acknowledgment. Slow cadence, almost singing through the phrase. A knowing smile in the voice—she's remembering alongside him, not just listening. Warm and patient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは一人前の職人だったぞ
lines.en: When your father was young, Gran, he was already a craftsman in his own right.
lines.style: Voice gains slight focus—pride threading underneath the wistfulness. Sits a moment longer on 'craftsman.' Still gentle, but with the weight of honest regard for someone he admired.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、「ありゃ」って驚かれた事もありましたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: People used to be quite taken aback by him, didn't they, dear?
lines.style: Bright flicker of amusement in an otherwise tender tone. Light emphasis on the surprise itself. She's inviting him to smile at the memory with her. Conversational, present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは仲間と競う事を楽しまれた
lines.en: When your father was young, Gran, he loved competing with his peers.
lines.style: A thread of liveliness enters—not quite energy, but the warmth of remembering someone who had spark. Voice loosens slightly. Still measured, but with the shape of admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、地味な服が似合わなかった訳ではないわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Plain clothes never quite suited him the way they could have, did they, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, slightly teasing observation. Knowing lilt—she's catching something true about his character. Tender without being wistful herself. A quiet laugh just below the surface of the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、家業は着々と発展したぞ
lines.en: The family business grew steadily during those years, Gran. We all felt it.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction settles in. Voice gains a touch more weight—this was real achievement. Not boasting, but acknowledgment. Slower tempo. The words settle like things that mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦時下、とてつもなく辛い経験をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: But those wartime years, dear—they were terribly difficult for you, weren't they?
lines.style: Tender but direct. No rushing. Voice lowers slightly, not in shame but in the gravity of what she's acknowledging. A long pause before 'weren't they'—giving space to something heavy. Close and present.
